trouverAmour.r1_t: Nothing is holding you back, you mostly lack opportunities
trouverAmour.r1_d: Your answers describe someone open: you give people a chance when you like them, and you don't run when things get serious. Your last relationship is behind you. If you are still single, it is mostly a question of meeting people: not enough new faces in your week, or not in the right places. That is the easiest brake to release.
trouverAmour.r1_a: Multiply the opportunities rather than the effort. A regular activity where you bump into the same people several weeks in a row beats ten parties where you talk to nobody. And when you like someone, give it time: first dates rarely tell the whole story.
trouverAmour.r2_t: One or two reflexes are slowing you down
trouverAmour.r2_d: You are open on the whole, but one or two answers show a reflex that costs you a lot: a slightly tight list of criteria, waiting for the other person to make the first move, or needing it to feel obvious from the start. Nothing serious. But these little reflexes filter out people who would have suited you.
trouverAmour.r2_a: Spot the reflex that looks most like you in your answers, and do the opposite once: get in touch first, say yes to a date outside your criteria, give a second chance to someone who didn't make an impression right away. If it is the idea of love at first sight that blocks you, the difference between attraction and feelings is worth a detour.
trouverAmour.r3_t: You protect yourself more than you search
trouverAmour.r3_d: Your answers show someone who wants to love and protects themselves at the same time. You pull back when things get serious, you wait for the other person to prove something, or you doubt what you are worth. There is often a story behind it: a disappointment, or a way of attaching learned very early. It is not set in stone, but it won't be fixed by switching apps.
trouverAmour.r3_a: Start by putting a name on the way you attach, anxious, avoidant or secure: it changes everything that comes after. Then, the next time you feel like running, stay one more week, just to see what happens. And if you step back as soon as the future comes up, fear of commitment has its reasons, and they can be understood.
trouverAmour.r4_t: The place is still taken, by the past or by fear
trouverAmour.r4_d: Your answers say one thing above all: you are not available right now. An ex who is still present, the idea that nobody will want you, or a single life that has become a shelter. It is neither a flaw nor a sentence. It is a place where people sometimes stay a long time, and which they leave, often with a little help.
trouverAmour.r4_a: Don't try to meet someone right away, it would only add a disappointment. Look first at what is taking up the space. If it is your ex, this test puts the facts in order. If it is the fear of missing someone or being left, the one on emotional dependency will tell you whether the lack speaks louder than love. And talking to someone, a friend or a professional, is nothing to be ashamed of.
trouverAmour.q1: In a normal week, you meet people you didn't know before…
trouverAmour.q1a: Often: at work, at the gym, at friends' places, by chance.
trouverAmour.q1b: From time to time, when an opportunity comes up.
trouverAmour.q1c: Rarely, your week always happens with the same people.
trouverAmour.q1d: Almost never, between work and home there is no room.
trouverAmour.q2: A friend invites you to a party where you won't know anyone.
trouverAmour.q2b: You go if you can come with someone.
trouverAmour.q2c: You say yes, then you find a reason to cancel.
trouverAmour.q2d: You decline, that kind of evening exhausts you in advance.
trouverAmour.q3: You like someone, but they don't tick one of your important boxes: job, height, city, age…
trouverAmour.q3a: You give it a chance, the box can wait.
trouverAmour.q3b: You hesitate, but you agree to see.
trouverAmour.q3c: You keep chatting, without believing in it.
trouverAmour.q3d: You stop there, you know what you want.
trouverAmour.q4a: Is behind you, you talk about it without any particular emotion.
trouverAmour.q4b: Left marks, but you have moved on.
trouverAmour.q4c: Comes back to your mind often, you compare without meaning to.
trouverAmour.q4d: Is not over for you, even if it is for the other person.
trouverAmour.q5: A relationship starts well, and after a few weeks it gets serious.
trouverAmour.q5a: You are glad, that is what you are looking for.
trouverAmour.q5b: You are happy, but you slow down a little.
trouverAmour.q5c: You find flaws you didn't see before.
trouverAmour.q5d: You pull back, and it often ends there.
trouverAmour.q6: A good person shows interest in you. Your first thought?
trouverAmour.q6a: Great, let's see where it goes.
trouverAmour.q6b: Nice, with a small twinge of doubt.
trouverAmour.q6c: They will be disappointed soon enough.
trouverAmour.q6d: They must want something else, there is no other explanation.
trouverAmour.q7: After a good first date, the other person doesn't reply for a whole day.
trouverAmour.q7a: You don't think about it much, people have lives.
trouverAmour.q7b: You check your phone a bit more than usual.
trouverAmour.q7c: You reread your messages to work out what you got wrong.
trouverAmour.q7d: You tell yourself it's over, and you send a message to make sure.
trouverAmour.q8: The people you are attracted to…
trouverAmour.q8a: Are quite different from one another.
trouverAmour.q8b: Look a bit alike, without it being a problem.
trouverAmour.q8c: Look very much alike, and it often ends the same way.
trouverAmour.q8d: Are always the same type, the one who isn't good for you.
trouverAmour.q9: If you met someone tomorrow, would you have time for them?
trouverAmour.q9a: Yes, there is room in your life.
trouverAmour.q9b: Yes, with a bit of reorganising.
trouverAmour.q9d: Honestly no, and you can't see what you would let go of.
trouverAmour.q10: On a first date, you are mostly…
trouverAmour.q10a: Yourself, curious about the other person.
trouverAmour.q10b: A bit tense at first, then fine.
trouverAmour.q10c: In interview mode: you check whether the person fits.
trouverAmour.q10d: Elsewhere: you talk a lot about yourself, or about your ex.
trouverAmour.q11a: Suits you, but you want to share it.
trouverAmour.q11b: Suits you well, you are not searching at all costs.
trouverAmour.q11c: Is so well organised that someone else would get in the way.
trouverAmour.q11d: Is a protection: alone, at least, you don't get hurt.
trouverAmour.q12: When your family or friends ask whether you have met someone…
trouverAmour.q12a: You answer calmly, it doesn't get to you.
trouverAmour.q12b: It annoys you a little, but it passes.
trouverAmour.q12c: It hurts, you feel like you are behind.
trouverAmour.q12d: You avoid the subject, or you make something up.
trouverAmour.q13: What you expect from meeting someone…
trouverAmour.q13a: Someone it feels easy with, the rest gets built.
trouverAmour.q13b: Something obvious fairly quickly, otherwise you doubt.
trouverAmour.q13c: Love at first sight, otherwise it's not the right person.
trouverAmour.q13d: Someone who understands you without you having to explain.
trouverAmour.q14: After a date that went well, are you the one who gets back in touch?
trouverAmour.q14a: Yes, or the other person, it doesn't matter who starts.
trouverAmour.q14b: You wait a little for the other person to make the first move.
trouverAmour.q14c: You wait for them to do it, otherwise it means they weren't interested.
trouverAmour.q14d: You don't get back in touch, you have already found what was wrong.
trouverAmour.q15: When you think about being single, the sentence that comes to you…
trouverAmour.q15a: I just haven't met the right person yet.
trouverAmour.q15b: I don't make enough effort, but it will come.
trouverAmour.q15c: There is something about me that doesn't work.
trouverAmour.q15d: Nobody will want me, I might as well stop hoping.
